description: USD value of a wallet on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism: native ETH plus major tokens (USDC and WETH everywhere, the common Base tokens on Base) and up to 20 tokens you add, each priced from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool, read live from the chain. Returns holdings, total and anything that could not be priced. Not a full token inventory. Use to check what a wallet is worth before trading, lending or paying. Costs $0.005 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

chain.description: Network: base (default), eth, arb or op

tokens.description: Optional extra comma-separated 0x token addresses (up to 20)
